summary: Nez Perce National Forest lookout with an L-4 cab, dated c.1930 and abandoned in 1950. No source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1950; no source describes what remains at the site.

staffing.status: 1922 staff named (C.A. Talcott, Jess Upham); no later staffing given

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts carries a Drive Up tag; no source we read states current access.

events.note: L-4 tower, dated 1930 (about 1930 on one site)
Staff named for 1922 (C.A. Talcott, Jess Upham); predates the 1930 L-4 tower

evidence.supports: elevation 5910 feet; Nez Perce National Forest

notes_for_editor: Brief design L-4 confirmed by three site pages. Brief access 'unknown' kept; the Drive Up tag is the only access signal and is not a current-condition claim. The 1922 staff predate the 1930 L-4 tower, so the listing may refer to an earlier structure; the story says the sources do not say. Elevation 5910 ft is in the story but has no facts key. No photos added.
